description: This file declares functions related to manipulating absolute and relative file paths, such as resolving real paths, concatenating prefixes with paths, and checking if a path is absolute. It serves as a header for path-related utilities used in the project.

methods.name: is_directory
methods.description: Determines if the given path points to a directory.

methods.name: strbuf_realpath
methods.description: Resolves the real path of a filename with error handling.

methods.name: strbuf_realpath_forgiving
methods.description: Resolves the real path of a filename, forgiving errors.

methods.name: real_pathdup
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the real path for a given filename.

methods.name: absolute_path
methods.description: Returns an absolute version of the input path.

methods.name: absolute_pathdup
methods.description: Returns a duplicate of the absolute path.

methods.name: prefix_filename
methods.description: Concatenates prefix and path, allocating a new string.

methods.name: prefix_filename_except_for_dash
methods.description: Concatenates prefix and path, with special handling if path is '-'.

methods.name: int is_absolute_path(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if the path is absolute.

methods.name: strbuf_add_absolute_path
methods.description: Adds an absolute path to a buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_add_real_path
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute one and appends it to a buffer.
